4.25 Acres of deer hunting a recreation in the town of Olean
Looking for a place to deer hunt or camp—in the city? This unique property offers the perfect combination of seclusion and accessibility, located just on the edge of the City of Olean and mere minutes from downtown. Nestled on a quiet dead-end road (Cherry Street), the property is accessed via a recorded easement, ensuring privacy and convenient entry.
Abundant deer sign throughout the land makes this a prime location for hunters or outdoor enthusiasts. The property borders several large tracts of undeveloped land on all sides, creating an expansive and uninterrupted hardwoods habitat for local wildlife—especially whitetail deer. Whether you’re seeking a quiet place to set up a hunting stand, build a camp, or just escape into nature without ever leaving the city limits, this is the rare opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
Don't miss this chance to own a hidden gem with close-to-town convenience.
